name: sequential_diluted_eps_contingent_shares
question_template: For a 12-month year, a company has net income {NI} USD, preferred dividends 60000 USD and 1000000 ordinary shares outstanding on day one, and issues {ISSUE} shares at the start of month {M}, weighted by whole months from month {M} through 12 over 12. Basic EPS is net income less preferred dividends over weighted shares. Potential shares: (1) 100000 shares issuable for no consideration if year-end revenue is at least 5000000 USD; actual revenue is {REV} USD. If met, they are unissued, excluded from basic EPS and included in diluted EPS all year with no earnings adjustment; otherwise excluded. (2) 200000 options, exercise price 20 USD, average market price {MKT} USD; treasury stock method applies only if market price exceeds exercise price, else no incremental shares. (3) Convertible bonds outstanding all year, face 2000000 USD, coupon {CPN} percent, convertible into {CONV} shares with full-year conversion; tax rate 25 percent. Sequential test: include the zero-incremental instruments (contingent shares and options) first, then the bonds only if their after-tax interest add-back per conversion share is strictly below diluted EPS computed with all prior inclusions. Compute diluted EPS; do not round intermediates.

slots.description: Exact weighted average ordinary shares for basic EPS.
Exact basic EPS after preferred dividends.
Exact incremental shares from options under the treasury stock method.
Exact after-tax interest add-back per bond conversion share.

program:
def solve():
    NI = Fraction(P["NI"])
    ISSUE = Fraction(P["ISSUE"])
    M = int(P["M"])
    REV = Fraction(P["REV"])
    MKT = Fraction(P["MKT"])
    CPN = Fraction(P["CPN"])
    CONV = Fraction(P["CONV"])
    pref = Fraction(60000)
    was = Fraction(1000000) + ISSUE * Fraction(13 - M) / Fraction(12)
    earnings = NI - pref
    basic = earnings / was
    cont = Fraction(100000) if REV >= Fraction(5000000) else Fraction(0)
    if MKT > Fraction(20):
        opt_inc = Fraction(200000) * (MKT - Fraction(20)) / MKT
    else:
        opt_inc = Fraction(0)
    run_num = earnings
    run_den = was + cont + opt_inc
    running = run_num / run_den
    addback = Fraction(2000000) * CPN / Fraction(100) * Fraction(3, 4)
    bond_inc_eps = addback / CONV
    if bond_inc_eps < running:
        diluted = (run_num + addback) / (run_den + CONV)
    else:
        diluted = running
    return {
        "final": diluted,
        "weighted_shares": was,
        "basic_eps": basic,
        "option_incremental_shares": opt_inc,
        "bond_incremental_eps": bond_inc_eps
    }
